evidence.note: Final-HEAD 39-check integration smoke passed and exercises ReviewRun-bound incremental envelopes through shared pass and quorum admissibility.

entries.desc: A pass from a valid current incremental envelope is accepted only after shared binding and digest re-verification; REVIEW, receipt, readiness, and quorum consume that same admissibility result.

evidence.note: 39-check executable quorum transcript proves REVIEW and quorum consume shared envelope admissibility, including incremental runs.

entries.desc: Mechanical or reviewer-requested escalation records its reason and binds the full envelope to the run so the obsolete incremental envelope cannot authorize the final pass.

evidence.note: Reviewer-requested and mechanical escalation produce full envelopes with new bound identity and explicit reason.

entries.desc: A pre-migration pass without Prompt Envelope fields remains legacy-full-context in its original round and cannot become an incremental prior pass through default values.

evidence.note: Unsigned or envelope-less legacy pass/run input cannot establish an incremental baseline and selects full.

entries.desc: Existing kind-aware material and scope freshness semantics remain intact; older open findings stay visible and empty storyFilesHash supplies no advisory signal.

evidence.note: Stale older pass-envelope issues are superseded only when the same lane has newer valid evidence; stale material and findings remain enforced.

entries.desc: Missing, unknown-version, malformed, or inconsistent incremental fields are rejected at envelope verification and cannot be repaired downstream.

evidence.note: Exact PromptEnvelope schema requires total incremental policy, freshness, files, basis, task-semantic and selection fields.

entries.desc: Single-field tampering across envelope, prior pass, Story, HEAD, lane, round, run, material, storyFiles, scope, policy, freshness, contracts, files, basis, or context digests invalidates the pass and downstream credit.

evidence.note: Replay/tamper tests prove mutated envelopes invalidate machine REVIEW and quorum through the shared verifier.

entries.desc: If incremental context was served when authoritative eligibility required full, a syntactically valid reviewer response cannot mint an admissible pass, receipt, host verdict, or quorum contribution.

evidence.note: Gate recomputes authoritative eligibility and rejects incremental mode whenever recomputation requires full; no pass/quorum credit survives.

entries.desc: Main, implementer, compatibility aliases, request payloads, cached sidecars, or caller objects cannot supply authoritative envelope fields, override mode, or bypass trusted assembly.

evidence.note: Strict schema and trusted review_run_start assembly reject caller-controlled unknown envelope fields and cross-role substitution.

entries.desc: Calling review_incremental_context changes no files, process events, Story metadata, review evidence, phases, guards, receipts, floor, quorum, or DONE outcome; it remains advisory until trusted assembly consumes the result.

evidence.note: Repeated 8x per-lane advisory calls are deterministic and preserve byte-identical Story/gate inputs and outcomes.

entries.desc: An incremental reviewer can read referenced current authoritative material and request full context with a recorded reason without accepting an incomplete basis.

evidence.note: Bound basis carries repository-relative authoritative references and reasoned reviewer escalation mints full.

entries.desc: Measurement records incremental and full sizes plus budget status while eligibility and escalation remain correctness decisions and violations stay separately auditable.

evidence.note: Measured full/incremental bytes and budgetViolation fields are independent of safety eligibility.

entries.desc: An incremental context exceeding its budget escalates to full without truncating required evidence or authorizing an incremental pass.

evidence.note: One-byte incremental budget selects full with INCREMENTAL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED and no truncation.

entries.desc: When safety requires full but full exceeds ordinary budget, correct full context remains available, the violation is recorded, and baseline or enforce convergence is blocked without incremental fallback.

evidence.note: Forced-full public-contract case stays full with budgetViolation=full under one-byte full budget.

entries.desc: When incremental is equal or larger, full is selected with FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL and repeated advisory calls remain deterministic and gate-neutral.

evidence.note: Oversized eligible basis selects FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL; advisory smoke separately proves repeated calls are gate-neutral.

entries.desc: Manipulated estimator metadata, caller sizes, omitted sections, compression claims, or budget values cannot override safety, erase a violation, or convert required full into incremental.

evidence.note: Budgets can only escalate incremental or record full violation; they never convert safety-required full into incremental.

entries.desc: Arguments cannot write passes, findings, scope acknowledgements, envelopes, receipts, host verdicts, quorum, or transitions; repeated and concurrent calls do not alter gates.

evidence.note: Read-only API has no evidence-write arguments and store/gate snapshots remain identical across repeated calls.

entries.desc: A campaign proves stale or untrusted evidence, public contracts, docs, private implementation, policy, authority, command, dynamic, parse-failure, and unknown-impact cases always select full while only proven bounded cases select incremental.

evidence.note: Executable campaign covers untrusted legacy, rename, docs, implementation, contract, authority, policy, dependency and unknown forced-full classes.
